title: TensorMutation: Learning Weight-Space Mutations of Deep Learning Models on Neural Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mutation testing for deep learning (DL) faces a cost-realism trade-off. The pre-training approach produces realistic but computationally expensive mutants, whereas existing post-training operators modify trained models efficiently but produce mutants that less closely resemble real faults. This study asks whether the trade-off is necessary: can the weight-space effect of a fault-informed pre-training mutation operator be predicted from a trained model, without retraining it? We answer this question with TensorMutation, which represents a trained model as a neural graph and uses a mutation-conditioned graph neural network (GNN) to predict parameter changes. The GNN is trained offline and reused across unseen models so that TensorMutation can generate executable mutants without retraining. translated_title: TensorMutation：在神经图上学习深度学习模型的权重空间变异
translated_abstract: 深度学习（DL）的变异测试面临成本与真实性之间的权衡。预训练方法能够产生真实的变异体，但计算代价高昂；而现有的训练后算子虽然可以高效地修改已训练模型，但其产生的变异体与真实故障的相似度较低。本研究探讨这种权衡是否必要：能否在已训练模型的基础上预测基于故障信息的预训练变异算子在权重空间中的影响，而无需重新训练？我们通过TensorMutation回答了这个问题：它将已训练的模型表示为神经图，并使用以变异为条件的图神经网络（GNN）来预测参数变化。该GNN在离线阶段完成训练，并可复用于未见过的模型，使TensorMutation无需重新训练即可生成可执行的变异体。我们使用11个基于故障信息的预训练算子，从71个多层感知机（MLP）分类器构建了包含25,252个原始-变异体对的语料库。
tldr: TensorMutation将训练好的深度学习模型表示为神经图，利用以变异为条件的图神经网络预测权重空间中的参数变化，从而无需重新训练即可生成接近真实故障的可执行变异体，消除了深度学习变异测试中成本与真实性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: TensorMutation represents trained DL models as neural graphs and uses a mutation-conditioned GNN to predict weight-space parameter changes, generating realistic executable mutants without retraining and eliminating the cost-realism trade-off in deep learning mutation testing.
